tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Search Teuida's 120 English-language articles about learning Korean and Japanese — pronunciation, grammar, slang, travel phrases, daily conversation, K-drama/K-pop, study methods, and app comparisons. Accepts Korean terms (받침, 존댓말), romanizations (batchim), or English. Returns titles, descriptions, categories and URLs — not article bodies. Use get_blog_post for an article's outline and FAQ.

query.description: Natural-language search phrase or keywords. Korean terms are accepted (받침, 존댓말), as are romanizations (batchim) and plain English.

category.description: Optional category filter. Omit to search every category.
